scope: Exactly one authorized public UI OTP request. No retry, code collection, verification, Google action, provider change, user-role grant or browser/network storage collection.
deliveryProvenScope: The original HTTP/UI request evidence alone. Subsequent user-confirmed receipt is recorded separately below.

ui.message: Je ontvangt een inlogcode op info@dgwebservices.nl. Controleer ook je spammap.

interpretation: The OTP endpoint intentionally returns a uniform valid-address response. HTTP 200 and code-entry UI do not prove provider acceptance, sending, delivery, a received code or a verified owner identity. An unverified Auth identity may have been created; this was not inspected.
